faq_items.question: What does sun and moon wall art symbolize?
faq_items.answer: Sun and moon wall art symbolizes balance, cycles, and togetherness, the pairing of opposites into one harmonious whole. Many people read it as a reminder of light and dark, day and night, or two people who complement each other, which is why it suits bedrooms and shared spaces so well.

faq_items.question: What size should I print sun and moon wall art?
faq_items.answer: Print it at 8x10 or 11x14 inches, since both sizes fit common store frames without custom matting. Choose 8x10 for nightstands and gallery walls, and 11x14 for a standalone statement piece. Always select actual size, not fit to page, so the art keeps its proportions.

faq_items.question: What kind of paper is best for printable wall art?
faq_items.answer: Matte cardstock of at least 65 lb (about 176 gsm) gives the best framed result. Matte finish kills glare behind glass and deepens warm boho tones, while the heavier weight keeps the print from looking flimsy. Bright white or natural cream both work, depending on your palette.

faq_items.question: Can I get this sun and moon print in color or black and white?
faq_items.answer: The printable is designed to look great in warm boho tones and in simple black-and-white line art, so it fits both colorful and minimalist rooms. Print it on cream paper for a softer, vintage feel, or on bright white for crisp, modern contrast. Your printer settings handle the rest.

faq_items.question: Is this printable really free to use?
faq_items.answer: Yes, it is completely free to download and print for personal use, with no email sign-up. You can hang it in your home, frame it as a gift, or print copies for several rooms. The only restriction is that you cannot resell the file or the finished prints.
